I am a 44-year-old woman farmer in Dedza with only 0.42 hectares of beans. I will not buy chemical fertilizer because beans fix their own nitrogen and fertilizer is too expensive and hard to find. I will apply some manure that I have saved from our livestock to help the soil, and I will plant the bean seed I kept from last year's harvest. We will do all the work ourselves—planting, weeding, and harvesting—because the plot is small and I do not have money to hire workers.
